title: Maximum potential difference
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the maximum potential difference as U_m = (m d² v₀²)/(q L²).

title: Exit velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final speed as v = (v₀/(3L))√(81L² + d²).

title: Kinematics perpendicular to plates
description: Important: Applies kinematics (y = ½at²) to relate vertical displacement to plate geometry (y ≤ d/2).

title: Force and acceleration relation
description: Important: Uses Newton's second law with electric force (F = qE = qU/d) to find acceleration a = qU/(md).

title: Time of flight calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes time to traverse plates using horizontal motion (t = L/v_horizontal).

title: Velocity vector composition
description: Important: Combines horizontal and vertical velocity components via Pythagorean theorem for final speed.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of derived expressions for potential difference and velocity.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for charge or misidentifies direction of acceleration/deflection.

title: Geometry constraint mistake
description: Pitfall: Sets vertical displacement equal to d instead of d/2, or misapplies the inequality condition.

title: Time of flight confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect horizontal velocity (v₀ instead of 3v₀) in part (2) when calculating time.
